title: Travel Packing Rewear Coverage
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe trip_name=* rewear_covered=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(rewear_covered="yes",1,0))) as matched by trip_name
| eval rewear_coverage_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - rewear_coverage_pct
description: Measures the percentage of packing plans that end with rewear coverage by trip.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which trip are helping or hurting packing plans.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `rewear coverage` on `style:wardrobe` events and summarize the hit rate by `trip_name`.
visualization: Table of trip with percentage of packing plans ending with rewear coverage.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often rewear coverage happens for each trip so you can see where packing plans go smoothly or get stuck.
